items.stem: In the Google Admin console, what is the main purpose of organizational units (OUs)?

options.text: To scope policies to groups of users or devices

OUs are not cloud IAM roles.

items.stem: Which TWO are ways to control extensions via Chrome policy? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Block extensions requesting a certain permission
options.rationale: Correct: permission-based blocking is a supported control.

items.explanation: Correct: force-install and permission blocking are extension controls.
